name: Daily Drama: The Four Users of the Agentic Future
author: Daily Drama
description: The agentic future has arrived. Four people used it.

add.title: Agent Adoption Report
add.body:
Errand Goblin, your autonomous agent, booked 4 rides in its busiest week.
One was the intern. One was the Goblin booking a ride for itself.

effects.text: {lab} agent usage up 400%; base was one
{lab}'s agent waitlist now longer than its user list, by design
Day one at {lab}. They gave me a badge that just says USER.

add.text: {lab}'s Errand Goblin books record four rides in peak week; board calls it "early traction"
Correction: of the four agent bookings reported yesterday, one was the agent booking itself
Open-ish AI ships 12 new agents this week; combined user base reaches double digits
Macrohard bundles agent into spreadsheet software; agent books a ride to a pivot table
Anthropomorphic publishes 40-page essay on whether the agent should book the ride. The ride has left
Super Super AI raises $30B for an agent that will book rides "eventually, in principle"
Sirocco releases open-weights agent by torrent at 3am; it immediately books itself a ride home
Analyst: "The agentic future is here. It is waiting for someone to tap Confirm"
Follow-up: the four people who used an AI agent last week say they "just wanted to see what happens"
MetaMeta offers $100M to each of the four agent users
I asked the agent to book me a cab. It asked 14 clarifying questions. I walked.
Launch deck says "agentic" 31 times. Dashboard says 4.
Our runway is long. Our user list is four names long.
Four tasks this week. I'm told that's a record. I am exhausted.
I booked a ride with nobody in it. Still counts as a user.
I'd use the agent, but tapping the button myself was faster.
Which one's the agent, the one in the hoodie or the one on the slide?
